title: guarded provisioned-throughput replay template
label: Guarded template for a model and region explicitly supported on provisioned throughput. The bundled profile and its acceptance targets are illustrative. Replace both with measured workload and agreed targets. This file starts at rate_scale 0.1 with 256 workers and 512 pending requests. Do not raise load until preflight, delivered-rate, queue, endpoint, quota, and cost evidence are healthy. Size mean occupancy from measured mean service time; tail latency is headroom evidence, not Little's Law. Shard only after one generator is proven insufficient.
